visual_action: A montage of American athletes and patriotic moments. Clips include an Olympic ice hockey player, an NFL player, and a college football player running with the American flag; military jets flying over a stadium; track athletes Sha'Carri Richardson and another unnamed male athlete celebrating with the flag; a baseball player hitting a home run; a wrestler celebrating; boxer Muhammad Ali in a vintage clip; and a large flag being displayed on a football field. The video concludes with a clip of Donald Trump hugging and kissing an American flag on stage.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Appears in the final clip of the montage, hugging and kissing an American flag.

cast.name: U.S. Army
cast.evidence: Mentioned in the lyrics of the background song: 'My daddy served in the army'.

on_screen_text.text: The FLAG has been there for our most memorable moments.

spoken_summary: The video is set to the song "Courtesy Of The Red, White And Blue (The Angry American)" by Toby Keith. The audible lyrics tell a story of a father who "served in the army," lost an eye, but proudly flew the American flag until he died, wanting his children "to grow up and live happy in the land of the free."
audio_music: A patriotic country song, "Courtesy Of The Red, White And Blue (The Angry American)" by Toby Keith, plays throughout the video, creating a proud and nostalgic tone.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of patriotic moments.
central_claim: The American flag represents the pinnacle of American achievement and patriotism, a legacy defended by the military and embodied by figures like Donald Trump.
intended_effect: To inspire feelings of patriotism and national pride, and to strongly associate Donald Trump with these emotions.
